rows.label: tlk43200142_04_msg0001
rows.name:
When you buy every item in a shop,
you can buy the right to become
that shop's owner!

rows.label: tlk43200142_04_msg0002
rows.name:
Once you obtain it, you'll receive
benefits permanently!

rows.label: tlk43200142_04_msg0003
rows.name:
But as you know, Merc Missions can
also increase the goods a shop
carries.

rows.label: tlk43200142_04_msg0006
rows.name:
Becoming an owner will be difficult,
but good luck.
